info.title: Broad Modelcard API
info.summary: Frozen frontend–backend contract for the Broad Modelcard pilot.
info.description: All data served by this API is synthetic demonstration data. Normative derivation rules (grades, statuses, rollups, fallbacks, multimorbidity) are defined in backend/CONTRACT.md. The API binds to 127.0.0.1 and has no authentication; it must not be exposed beyond the local machine.

get.summary: Axes, status vocabulary and bands, chapters, dataset version, synthetic-data notice.
Model registry with use-case variants.
Every configuration as one catalogue tile: registry fields, status distributions, chapter snapshot, last update.
get.description: One tile per registry model and use case, in registry order, at the all-population lens (context Clinical). Counts cover the depth-1 top-level conditions with the statuses /metrics/map and /metrics/summary serve. Cached per dataset version (and staged upload). Added in v1.6; semantics in CONTRACT.md §17.

get.summary: Chapters, blocks, and the top-level conditions needed to lay out the atlas ring (2,400 in ICD-11).
One chapter's blocks and every level-2 concept inside it, including deeper categories.
Compact per-concept statuses for all four metric views, for coloring the ring.
get.description: scope=atlas returns blocks (rollups) and top-level conditions; scope=chapter returns the chapter's blocks and level-2 concepts (deeper concepts resolve through their metric anchor). All four views are returned so switching the metric view needs no request.

parameters.name: chapter_id
parameters.description: Required when scope=chapter.

get.summary: Status counts over all top-level conditions and per chapter, for the ring centre and the Summary highlights.

parameters.name: weights
parameters.description: v1.14 (CONTRACT.md §30): prevalence adds weighted_distribution, each status's share of the prevalence weight of the depth-1 conditions (§6's weights; a local population's for a population read). Absent: the summary is byte for byte what it was. Other values: 422 invalid_parameter.

get.summary: Full metric row with grades, statuses, warnings, safeguards, and provenance for one concept (chapter, block, or condition).

200.description: Concept metrics. `metrics` is null when no row exists. Since v1.13 a row whose evidence grade a linked study entered carries `appraisal` (CONTRACT.md §22).

get.summary: For every one-group lens, how many of a card's depth-1 ICD-11 conditions have a result in the group, have none, and differ from all patients by the Across groups rule (CONTRACT.md §24). A heuristic, never a grade.
get.description: Added in v1.14 (CONTRACT.md §24). One request for the Summary's Across groups block: per one-group lens the counts over the card's depth-1 ICD-11 conditions and up to 5 flagged conditions, largest |delta| first. The rule is getConceptSubgroups' (/meta.subgroup_difference), with the same layers for a local population with local results. ontology is validated like every read, but the counts are always over ICD-11 (classification_basis icd11), so the answer names no ontology.

get.summary: One concept's result at all patients and at every one-group lens (one specific age, sex, or ethnicity group, the other axes at All), with a difference flag per group (CONTRACT.md §24).
get.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §24). Takes no lens: it lists every one-group lens in one response. The difference flag is a prototype heuristic published in /meta.subgroup_difference; it is not a grade and changes no status. With ontology (§23) the concept resolves as in getConceptMetrics and the body names its mapping.

200.description: The concept at all patients and at each one-group lens.

get.summary: The study records of the version, in stored order; optionally those that evaluated one model version.
get.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §22). A model filter that matches nothing gives an empty list, not 404.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Only the studies that evaluated this model version (model_version).

get.summary: One study record.
get.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §22). An id the version does not hold: 404 unknown_study.

get.summary: The intervention effects of the version (what using an AI system changed for patients or care, from a study that compared care with and without it), in stored order; optionally of one AI system or one card. Never graded.
get.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §27). Filters that match nothing give an empty list, not 404. Effects never enter a grade, status, Overview, comparison flag, or summary.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Only the effects of this AI system (model_version).

parameters.name: use_case
parameters.description: Only the effects of this function (use case).

get.summary: 2 to 4 cards side by side over the chapters, or a chapter's subchapters and conditions, with comparability per row.
get.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §25). Each cell is what the atlas map serves for that card at the lens, population, and ontology; each row says whether the cards' results are directly comparable and, if not, why (reason codes with the cards they concern; the rule is published in /meta.comparison, a prototype heuristic). scope=atlas gives one row per chapter; scope=chapter the chapter's blocks, each followed by its depth-1 conditions.

parameters.name: cards
parameters.description: 2 to 4 distinct card ids, comma-separated: <model_version>|<use_case> each (URL-encoded). Otherwise 422 invalid_cards; an unknown model or use case is 404.

parameters.name: chapter_id
parameters.description: Required when scope=chapter.

get.summary: Concepts that can start (no selection) or extend the selected combination, with display statuses for coloring.

parameters.name: chapter_id
parameters.description: Required when scope=chapter.

get.summary: The stored metric row for the exact selected combination (two or more conditions).

200.description: Combination metrics. `metrics` is null when no stored combination matches.

get.summary: Case-insensitive substring search over the classification's codes (ICD-11 by default), concept id, preferred and fully specified name.

200.description: Matches ranked best first (v1.12, CONTRACT.md §9): exact code, code prefix, exact preferred term, preferred term that starts with the query or holds it as a whole word, a word that starts with the query, any other match; then shorter codes or terms, level, and preferred term. Since v1.14 (§31), in ICD-11 and when the store imported synonyms: concepts found by a synonym only follow every other match, each with match synonym and its matched_term.

get.summary: Read a plain-language query as chips: AI system, function, conditions, age, sex, ethnicity, care setting (ICD-11).
get.description: Added in v1.14 (CONTRACT.md §31). Deterministic rules: recognized words become chips with the contract value each names; the reader sees them and applies them. Conditions are found with the ICD-11 search, synonyms included. Nothing is applied.

200.description: The chips, ordered by kind, and the words no rule recognized.

post.summary: Ask the configured helper to read a query as chips; every chip is checked against the vocabularies (optional, off by default).
post.description: Added in v1.14 (CONTRACT.md §20, §31). Only when the study helper is configured (409 assist_not_configured otherwise). Sends the query text and the chip vocabularies (AI systems, functions, lens values, care settings) to the configured provider, nothing else; conditions are looked up in the ICD-11 search. Chips outside the vocabularies are dropped with a reason. Not cached (Cache-Control: no-store).

200.description: The checked chips, the words the helper could not place, and the dropped chips.

get.summary: Condition model card as JSON (the PDF is rendered client-side from this payload).
Full assembled dataset for one model and use case, streamed as a download (exempt from the 2 MB response budget).

population.description: The local population the export uses (v1.10); absent for the default population.

post.summary: Statuses, warnings, safeguards, and safety incidents on one card for ICD-11 codes and a coarse population (the live interaction plugin).
post.description: Added in v1.8 (CONTRACT.md §19). The body is shaped like a CDS Hooks context; unknown keys anywhere are rejected (422). POST, so case inputs never appear in URLs or access logs; nothing is stored or logged, and the response carries Cache-Control: no-store. Demonstration on synthetic data, not for clinical use.

200.description: One entry per code, in request order, and the stored combination of the matched conditions (or null).

get.summary: One card as a compact record for operational systems: AI system, card, studies, effects, incidents, chapter statuses, Overview counts.
get.description: Added in v1.14 (CONTRACT.md §32.1). ICD-11, all patients, Any setting, the default prevalence; public safety incidents only. Under 300 KB. format=jsonld serves the same content as JSON-LD (application/ld+json, §32.3). Synthetic demonstration data; never a certification or an approval.

parameters.name: format

schema.description: json (the default) or jsonld: the same content as JSON-LD with MCRO terms (CONTRACT.md §32.3).

parameters.description: json (the default) or jsonld: the same content as JSON-LD with MCRO terms (CONTRACT.md §32.3).

200.description: The card record (JSON), or with format=jsonld the same content as JSON-LD.

get.summary: CDS Hooks discovery: the local service bmc-condition-status on patient-view (synthetic demonstration).
get.description: Added in v1.14 (CONTRACT.md §33). Local only; no CORS. The extension names the default card and the dataset version.

200.description: The CDS Hooks discovery document: one service.

post.summary: CDS Hooks service bmc-condition-status: one CDS card per condition of a synthetic patient (demonstration, not for clinical use).
post.description: Added in v1.14 (CONTRACT.md §33). A CDS Hooks 2.0 patient-view request, parsed by hand; codings in ICD-11 MMS or ICD-10-CM (mapped through the §23 crosswalk). Malformed: 400. Nothing is stored or logged (Cache-Control: no-store).

200.description: One CDS card per condition, in request order. Cache-Control: no-store.

get.summary: The six maintainable data sets with current version, last update, counts, and any staged upload.
Upload template. XLSX templates include an instructions sheet and dropdowns for allowed values.

parameters.name: filled
parameters.description: Include the current live data, so it can be edited and uploaded again.

parameters.name: model_version
parameters.description: Required with filled=true for kind=metrics and kind=multimorbidity.

parameters.name: use_case
parameters.description: Required with filled=true for kind=metrics and kind=multimorbidity.

parameters.name: population_id
parameters.description: With kind=population and filled=true (v1.10): that local population's tiers (404 unknown_population). Without it, a filled population template holds the default tiers to edit. With kind=local_metrics and filled=true (v1.13, §26): required.

post.summary: Stage a CSV/XLSX upload and start validation. Only one staged upload per data set.

replace_staged.description: Discard an existing staged upload for this data set instead of failing with 409.

mode.description: replace (default) swaps the data set; merge (metrics, prevalence, safety; studies, effects, and local_metrics since v1.13) changes only the file's rows (v1.7, CONTRACT.md §11.2).

population_id.description: Required for kind=population (v1.10, CONTRACT.md §21): the local population's id, e.g. northbridge-region (422 invalid_parameter otherwise). Also required for kind=local_metrics (v1.13, §26): the published local population of the results.

population_name.description: kind=population (v1.10): the name shown on every view that uses the population; required for a new population, else the live name is kept.

submission_id.description: v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26): join this developer submission; it never publishes on its own.

post.summary: Stage JSON records as a merge upload in template form and start validation (the one-record form, the helper).
post.description: Added in v1.7 (CONTRACT.md §11.4). The records become a template-form CSV (header row 1, record i in row i + 2) that is checked like an uploaded file; report examples carry the record index. Only one staged upload per data set.

get.summary: Upload status, validation progress, and validation report.

delete.summary: Discard a staged upload. Live data is never affected.

get.summary: The uploaded file with errors marked (highlighted cells in XLSX, an error column in CSV).
What publishing this valid upload would change, in rows, AI systems, functions, and status shifts.

post.summary: Atomically publish a valid staged upload as a new dataset version. Publishes are serialized.
Publish a new version without this local population (v1.10); history keeps it, so a rollback restores it.
post.description: CONTRACT.md §21. Takes the optional change note like rollbackVersion. 404 unknown_population when the live version has no such population; 409 publish_in_progress while another publish runs.

200.description: The removal published as a new version.

get.summary: Stored safety incidents (open, mitigated, and closed), newest first, for editing in the Data Library.
get.description: Added in v1.11 (CONTRACT.md §18). Without model and use_case, every incident; with model, that AI system's; with both, one card's. A filter that matches nothing gives an empty list.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Only the incidents of this AI system (model_version).

parameters.name: use_case
parameters.description: Only the incidents of this function (use case).

get.summary: Published dataset versions, newest first.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Only the versions that changed this data set, plus those that cover every data set (the initial import).

post.summary: Restore the data set as of this version by publishing a new version; history is never deleted.
post.description: CONTRACT.md §11. 404 unknown_version; 409 publish_in_progress, rollback_conflict, or (v1.11) rollback_no_change when the chosen data sets already equal version n: no version is added; 422 invalid_rollback when kind and every_kind are both given.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: The data set to restore. Default: the one this version changed, or every data set for a version that covers all (the initial import).

parameters.name: every_kind
parameters.description: Restore every data set to this version in one new version (v1.11). Cannot be combined with kind.

200.description: Rollback published as a new version.

get.summary: Whether the assisted data entry helper is on, with which provider and model. Never returns the API key.
get.description: Added in v1.9 (CONTRACT.md §20).

200.description: The helper's status (never the API key).

put.summary: Turn the helper on: a hosted model with your own API key, or a local OpenAI-compatible model. The key is write-only.

200.description: The helper is on; its new status (never the API key).

delete.summary: Turn the helper off and delete its configuration, including the API key.

post.summary: Propose metrics or safety records from one study (PDF, text, CSV, XLSX, or pasted text). Proposes only; nothing is staged or published.
post.description: Added in v1.9 (CONTRACT.md §20). Sends the study to the configured provider and checks its answer against the store: only cards and ICD-11 codes that exist are proposed; the rest are listed in dropped with a reason. Each field carries its source quote, location, and uncertainty. Accept records by sending them to createRecordsUpload (CONTRACT.md §20).

kind.description: The data set to propose records for.

file.description: The study: PDF (hosted model only), .txt, .md, .csv, or .xlsx, at most 10 MB.

text.description: Pasted study text, instead of a file (at most 200,000 characters).

model_version.description: Optional card: used when the study names none; records for other cards are dropped.

schema.description: One study: file or text (exactly one), the data set kind, and optionally a card.

200.description: Proposed records with sources and flags, and the dropped items. Nothing was staged or published.

get.summary: The developer's narrow model card of one AI system (v1.13), or null when it has none. Never verified.
get.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26). An AI system the version lacks: 404 unknown_model.

200.description: The narrow model card, or null.

get.summary: Published dataset versions, newest first (v1.13): what changed, when, why, and in which role; for operational systems.
get.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26): what changed, when, why, and in which workspace role; `after` lists only newer versions.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Only versions newer than this one (e.g. the last version a system saw).

parameters.name: card
parameters.description: v1.14 (CONTRACT.md §26.6): only the versions that changed this card, <model_version>|<use_case> (URL-encoded), by the rule of the catalogue's last_updated (§17). A card no version holds gives an empty list; a value that is not a card id is 422 invalid_parameter.

get.summary: The safety incidents of the version (open, mitigated, and closed), newest first; optionally of one AI system or one card (v1.14). The public read of what the Data Library's incident list serves.
get.description: Added in v1.14 (CONTRACT.md §18, §30). The same records and order as the admin listIncidents, as a public read with an ETag. A filter that matches nothing gives an empty list, not 404. All incidents are synthetic.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Only the incidents of this AI system (model_version).

parameters.name: use_case
parameters.description: Only the incidents of this function (use case).

put.summary: Set the instance profile (v1.13): public service or hospital version, organisation, who maintains it, and (v1.14) a data-protection note. /meta serves it.
put.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26). Not a dataset version; /meta serves it.

post.summary: Open a developer submission (v1.13); its uploads join it with submission_id and wait for a custodian.

get.summary: Developer submissions, newest first (v1.13): the custodian's queue.
get.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26).

get.summary: One developer submission with its uploads (v1.13).
get.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26). Unknown id: 404 unknown_submission.

post.summary: Accept a submission (v1.13): publish its uploads, one version each, with the custodian's note and name.
post.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26). 409 submission_not_ready while a part is not valid; 409 submission_closed once decided.

200.description: The accepted submission with its published versions.

post.summary: Return a submission to its developer with a required note (v1.13); its staged uploads are discarded.
post.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26). A note is required; the staged uploads are discarded.

post.summary: Stage a narrow model card (v1.13): JSON or Markdown text for one AI system, checked in the background.
post.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26). JSON or Markdown with a simple front matter subset; at most 1 MB.

202.description: Upload accepted; the card is checked asynchronously.

get.summary: Metric records proposed from a staged narrow model card's results with ICD-11 codes (v1.13); nothing is staged.
get.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26). Nothing is staged: send a batch to createRecordsUpload.

post.summary: Stage an evaluation results file (v1.14): a benchmark or harness run for one card as JSON, checked in the background; it publishes nothing.
post.description: Added in v1.14 (CONTRACT.md §32.2). Format bmc-evaluation-results/1 (docs/evaluation-results.md), at most 1 MB. A valid upload offers proposed records (getEvaluationProposals); it is never published itself.

202.description: Upload accepted; the file is checked asynchronously.

get.summary: Records proposed from a valid evaluation results upload (v1.14): one benchmark study and one metrics merge record per result; nothing is staged.
get.description: Added in v1.14 (CONTRACT.md §32.2). Nothing is staged: send the study, then the metrics batch, to createRecordsUpload.

200.description: The proposed study record, metrics records, and the check's notes.

get.summary: Download the live public layers as a public release bundle (v1.13, public instances only): gzip SQLite with a manifest.
get.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26). Public instances only (409 not_public_instance).

post.summary: Check a public release bundle on a hospital instance (v1.13) and summarize what publishing it would change.
post.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26). Hospital instances only (409 not_hospital_instance); bundles up to 512 MB.

file.description: A public release bundle (.sqlite.gz) exported by a public instance.

get.summary: A release import's check result and change summary (v1.13).
get.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26).

delete.summary: Discard a release import that was not published (v1.13). Live data is never affected.

post.summary: Publish a valid release import as one version (v1.13): public layers replaced, local layers kept.
post.description: Added in v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26). One version: public layers replaced, local layers kept.

DatasetVersion.description: Dataset version the response was computed from: a positive integer, or staged:<upload_id>.

Population.description: The local population the response was computed for (v1.10, CONTRACT.md §21); absent for the default population.

Ontology.description: The ontology the response was read in (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §23); absent for ICD-11.

Version.name: version
Version.description: live (default) or staged:<upload_id> to read a staged, unpublished upload layered over live data.

Context.name: context
Context.description: The care setting (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §29), a /meta axes.context value: Clinical (the default, shown as Any setting; every row stored without a setting) or a specific setting, which reads only the rows stored for it (No data where it stores none). Other values: 422 invalid_lens.

SummaryView.name: view
SummaryView.description: A metric view, or safety (v1.7): conditions by safety mark.

Selected.name: selected
Selected.description: Selected condition concept ids in selection order, comma-separated. Deeper concepts are canonicalized to their metric anchor.

Population.name: population
Population.description: A local population id from /meta populations (v1.10, CONTRACT.md §21). Its tiers replace the default prevalence for this request only; absent: the default population. Unknown: 404 unknown_population.

Ontology.name: ontology
Ontology.description: An ontology id from /meta ontologies (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §23): icd11 (the default; the same as leaving it out), icd10cm, or mondo when the store imported them. Other ontologies serve the mapped ICD-11 results; the answer names the ontology in `ontology` and X-Ontology. Unknown: 404 unknown_ontology.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. unknown_model, unknown_use_case, invalid_lens, unknown_concept, unknown_upload, invalid_version, invalid_scope, missing_chapter_id, invalid_view, invalid_selection, invalid_cards, invalid_query, invalid_limit, invalid_parameter, not_found, method_not_allowed, store_unavailable, internal_error, staged_upload_exists, upload_not_valid, upload_not_staged, upload_outdated, upload_too_large, unsupported_file_type, publish_in_progress, rollback_conflict, rollback_no_change, unknown_version, local_only, backend_unavailable, assist_not_configured, assist_provider_error, assist_unsupported_input, assist_busy, unknown_submission, submission_closed, submission_not_ready, submission_upload, not_public_instance, not_hospital_instance, unknown_import, import_not_valid, import_not_staged, invalid_bundle, bundle_checksum, bundle_atlas_mismatch (v1.13, §26), invalid_cds_request (v1.14, §33).

PopulationRef.description: The local population a read used (v1.10); absent on default reads.

PopulationInfo.description: A local population a read can name with population=<id> (v1.10).

codes.description: How many codes the population lists; every other condition keeps the default tier.

updated_version.description: The version that put its current set in place; null for a staged set.

OntologyId.description: An ontology id (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §23): icd11, icd10cm, mondo.

MappingKind.description: How a condition of another ontology reaches ICD-11 (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §23). none: No mapping, no result.

OntologyRef.description: The ontology a read used (v1.13); absent on ICD-11 reads.

ConfigurationCounts.description: Of the linked depth-1 conditions (AppraisalCounts.linked), how many rest on studies of the card's current configuration, of an earlier one, or of one not stated (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28.5). Information only.

AppraisalCounts.description: Depth-1 conditions with an evidence grade at the lens, and how many of them rest on a stored row linked to a study record (2026-10-21, CONTRACT.md §22). Sent only when at least one is linked.

OntologyInfo.description: An ontology the atlas reads accept with ontology=<id> (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §23).

is_default.description: True for ICD-11, the storage key of every result.

mapping_counts.description: Depth-1 conditions by crosswalk kind; null for ICD-11.

sources.description: The pinned releases the import read (empty for ICD-11).

ConceptMapping.description: A level-2 concept's crosswalk to ICD-11 (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §23).

icd11.description: The ICD-11 concept whose result is served: a condition (level 2) or a block (level 1); null for none.

via.description: kind parent: the parent whose mapping is inherited.

steps.description: kind parent: is_a steps up to the via concept (1 or 2).

source.description: Which table or cross-reference the mapping came from.

source_code.description: The code the source was read under (ICD-10 code, foundation id).

icd11_code.description: The ICD-11 MMS code the source named, before it was resolved to the atlas.

Status.description: not_validated was merged into no_data in v1.11 (CONTRACT.md §4.5).

SummaryView.description: getMetricSummary's views (v1.7): the metric views and safety.

SafetyMark.description: Derived severity of open (and mitigated) safety incidents (CONTRACT.md §18).

ContextLens.description: The care setting, the Context axis (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §29). Clinical is Any setting.

DatasetKind.description: studies (CONTRACT.md §22), effects (§27), and local_metrics and model_cards (§26) were added in v1.13.

UploadKind.description: What an upload can be (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §32.2): a data set kind, or evaluation_results, which are no data set and publish nothing.

UploadMode.description: v1.7: replace swaps the data set (or the card's data); merge adds, replaces, or removes only the uploaded rows (CONTRACT.md §11.2).

context.description: The Context axis: Clinical (Any setting), then since v1.14 the specific care settings (CONTRACT.md §29).

StatusBand.description: Prototype heuristic, not a clinical standard. min inclusive, max exclusive; null means unbounded.

status_bands.description: Score bands per graded view. Evidence bands apply to the derived evidence signal.

overall_score_weights.description: Weights of the overall score terms (CONTRACT.md §4.4). Added in v1.3.

overall_score_weights_without_intended_u.description: Weights for a row without an intended-use value (a card without an intended-use statement, or a row that gives none): the intended-use term dropped, the others scaled to 100% (CONTRACT.md §4.4). Added in v1.11.

populations.description: Local populations of this version that reads can name with population=<id> (v1.10, CONTRACT.md §21); always sent, empty when there are none.

evidence_signal_weights.description: Weights of the evidence signal's terms (CONTRACT.md §4.2). Added in v1.13; always sent.

evidence_study_adjustments.description: How a linked study record changes a row's evidence signal (CONTRACT.md §22). Added in v1.13; always sent.

guideline_followed.description: Added when the study's reporting guideline was followed (yes).

subgroup_difference.description: The rule that flags a group in getConceptSubgroups (CONTRACT.md §24); a prototype heuristic, not a grade. Added in v1.13; always sent.

min_delta.description: Smallest |group perf − all-patients perf| that can be flagged.

requires_ci_separation.description: Whether the two confidence intervals must not overlap.

ontologies.description: The ontologies the atlas reads accept, ICD-11 first (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §23); always sent, ICD-11 alone when the store imported none.

comparison.description: The comparability rule of getComparison: card limits, reason codes, design groups (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §25); always sent.

instance.description: Who runs this copy of the tool: a public service or a hospital version (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §26); always sent.

function_category.description: Category of the function (the use case). Added in v1.5; null when not given.

declarations.description: Developer declarations for this configuration. Added in v1.5; null when none is given.

intended_use_defined.description: Whether the card has an intended-use statement (v1.11); absent means true. When false, every intended-use field of the card is null and its scores leave intended use out (CONTRACT.md §4.4).

configuration.description: The card's configuration record (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28.1); sent only when one of its fields is given.

performance_measure.description: What the card's figures measure, e.g. Top-3 diagnostic accuracy. Sent only when given (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28.1).

reference_standard.description: What the figures are measured against. Sent only when given (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28.1).

settings.description: v1.14 (CONTRACT.md §29): the care settings the card's metrics store rows for, Clinical (Any setting) first; sent only when the card stores a specific setting, so absent means Any setting only.

kind.description: Model or product ("AI system" in the UI). Added in v1.5; an entry without a kind is a model.

ai_type.description: Added in v1.5; null when not given.

developer.description: Added in v1.5; null when not given.

release_date.description: ISO date. Added in v1.5; null when not given.

description.description: Added in v1.5; null when not given.

built_on.description: Products only: model versions of this registry the product is built on. Added in v1.5; empty for models.

replaces.description: Version lineage (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28.2): the model version this AI system supersedes; sent only when given.

replaced_by.description: Version lineage (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28.2): the entries whose replaces names this one, in registry order (derived); sent only when not empty.

Declarations.description: What the developer declares about one configuration (model × use case). Broad Modelcard does not verify it (contract v1.5; the four data-protection declarations since v1.14).

declared_data_use.description: How the AI system uses patient data. Data-protection declaration (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28); the four are sent together, only when one of them is given. Never verified.

declared_data_location.description: Where the data is processed and stored. Data-protection declaration (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28); the four are sent together, only when one of them is given. Never verified.

declared_retention.description: How long the data is kept. Data-protection declaration (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28); the four are sent together, only when one of them is given. Never verified.

declared_privacy_contact.description: Contact for data-protection questions. Data-protection declaration (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28); the four are sent together, only when one of them is given. Never verified.

ConfigurationRecord.description: The deployed configuration of a card (contract v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28.1): every field, null (tools: empty) when not given. A summary of the prompt, never the prompt itself. Stated by the developer; not verified.

configuration_id.description: A label, e.g. cfg-2026-09. A change moves the card's last_updated (§17).

configuration_date.description: ISO date the configuration took effect.

prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the full prompt, lower-case hex.

Catalogue.description: One tile per configuration (registry model × use case), in registry order, at the all-population lens. Added in v1.6 (CONTRACT.md §17).

condition_count.description: The depth-1 top-level conditions every distribution counts.

snapshot_blocks.description: The subchapters (blocks), in atlas order, that every tile's snapshot lists (v1.11, CONTRACT.md §17); always sent.

population.description: The local population this answer uses (v1.10, CONTRACT.md §21); absent for the default population.

system.description: The registry entry ("AI system") of the tile (CONTRACT.md §11.1).

status.description: Registry status; the catalogue's status filter uses it (CONTRACT.md §17).

replaces.description: Version lineage (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28.2): the model version this AI system supersedes; sent only when given.

replaced_by.description: Version lineage (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28.2): the entries that supersede this one (derived); sent only when not empty.

intended_use_defined.description: Whether the card has an intended-use statement (v1.11); absent means true.

configuration.description: The card's configuration record (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28.1); sent only when one of its fields is given.

performance_measure.description: What the card's figures measure, e.g. Top-3 diagnostic accuracy. Sent only when given (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28.1).

reference_standard.description: What the figures are measured against. Sent only when given (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28.1).

distribution.description: Conditions per status for each view at the catalogue lens; each view's counts sum to condition_count.

intended_use.description: Null for a card without an intended-use statement (v1.11).

chapters.description: Every chapter, in chapter order, also those without conditions.

snapshot.description: Per subchapter, aligned with the catalogue's snapshot_blocks (v1.11, CONTRACT.md §17); always sent.

overview.description: Each subchapter's Overview status at the catalogue lens, as the atlas map serves it; a rollup without children reads no_data.

safety.description: Each subchapter's safety mark from open and mitigated incidents at the catalogue lens, or null.

The card's safety incidents over every lens (v1.7, CONTRACT.md §17, §18): serious and caution count the open incidents by derived severity (serious + caution = open); open, mitigated, and closed count every incident by status.

last_updated.description: The newest published version that changed this configuration, and when it was published (CONTRACT.md §17).

staged_change.description: True in a staged read when the staged upload changes this configuration; always false in live reads.

depth_in_kind.description: Level-2 only: 1 for top-level conditions, 2–3 for deeper categories.

metric_anchor_id.description: Level-2 only: the depth-1 condition whose metrics this concept inherits.

prevalence_score.description: Score used for bubble size, ordering, and rollup weights (CONTRACT.md §5).

code.description: Reads in another ontology (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §23) only: the ontology's own code (ICD-10-CM code or section, MONDO id); null for a grouping without one. icd11_code is then null.

conditions.description: The depth-1 top-level conditions (2,400 in ICD-11).

population.description: The local population this answer uses (v1.10, CONTRACT.md §21); absent for the default population.

ontology.description: The ontology this answer is read in (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §23); absent for ICD-11.

concepts.description: All level-2 concepts in the chapter, including deeper categories.

population.description: The local population this answer uses (v1.10, CONTRACT.md §21); absent for the default population.

ontology.description: The ontology this answer is read in (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §23); absent for ICD-11.

MetricMap.description: Columnar to stay small. Each row is an array aligned with `columns`; clients read columns by name. `child_count` (v1.10): for a block or chapter row, how many conditions it aggregates at the lens (`provenance.rollup.child_count`); null for every other row. A rollup with `child_count` 0 is served as before (out of scope, CONTRACT.md §6) and clients present it as No data (§13, V1).

population.description: The local population this answer uses (v1.10, CONTRACT.md §21); absent for the default population.

mapping.description: Reads in another ontology (v1.13) only: each row's crosswalk kind, aligned with rows; null for block and chapter rows (rollups), none for one none of whose conditions maps. Kind none has no result: No mapping.

ontology.description: The ontology this answer is read in (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §23); absent for ICD-11.

layer.description: v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26), ICD-11 reads for a local population with local results for the card only: aligned with rows, local for a condition served from local results, includes_local for a block or chapter with at least one such condition, else null.

appraisal.description: 2026-10-21 (CONTRACT.md §22), only when at least one row of the answer rests on a study record: aligned with rows, linked for a condition whose result rests on a stored row linked to a study record, includes_linked for a result that aggregates conditions (a block, a chapter, or a condition mapped to an ICD-11 block) at least one of which is linked, else null (no study appraisal). Absent: no row of the answer is linked.

MetricSummary.description: Counts over depth-1 top-level conditions. For view=intended_use, strong/moderate/weak are zero and in-scope levels are reported in intended_use_counts. For view=safety (v1.7), counts are all zero and safety_counts holds the conditions by safety mark.

intended_use_counts.description: view=intended_use only; null for a card without an intended-use statement (v1.11).

population.description: The local population this answer uses (v1.10, CONTRACT.md §21); absent for the default population.

mapping_counts.description: Reads in another ontology (v1.13) only: the conditions by crosswalk kind; those of kind none count as no_data.

appraisal_counts.description: 2026-10-21 (CONTRACT.md §22), only when at least one graded condition rests on a study record: the depth-1 conditions with an evidence grade at the lens and how many of them are linked to a study record. Any view.

configuration_counts.description: v1.14 (CONTRACT.md §28.5), sent exactly when appraisal_counts is: the linked conditions by the configuration their studies evaluated (the card's current one, an earlier one, or not stated). Never a grade.

weighted_distribution.description: v1.14 (CONTRACT.md §30), only with weights=prevalence: each status's share of the prevalence weight of the depth-1 conditions (§6's weights; a local population's for a population read), rounded to 4 decimals. Keys: the five statuses of counts (overall, performance, evidence), in_scope, partially_in_scope, out_of_scope, and no_data (intended_use), or serious, caution, and none (safety). Never a grade.

ontology.description: The ontology this answer is read in (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §23); absent for ICD-11.

SafetyCounts.description: Conditions by safety mark (v1.7, CONTRACT.md §18); none: no open or mitigated incident applies.

Warning.description: Copy (titles, patient and expert text) is owned by the frontend and keyed by code.

share.description: Aggregated rows only (rollups, several-row demographic fallback): how many of the aggregated rows carry this warning (CONTRACT.md §6, §7). Absent on stored rows and on warnings about the aggregate itself. Added in v1.4.

id.description: Rules in CONTRACT.md §4.6. evidence-missing and overall-weak were added in v1.4.

lens_fallback.description: True when the exact demographic combination was absent and the row was aggregated or substituted (CONTRACT.md §7, §8).

data_source.description: getConceptMetrics only (v1.7): where the stored row's values come from; null for aggregated rows (CONTRACT.md §11.3).

layer.description: v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26): local for a row served from a hospital's local evaluation results (a read that names the local population); absent on every public row.

evidence_grade.description: Derived grade (CONTRACT.md §4.2), not the stored source grade.

in_intended_use.description: Null when the row has no intended-use value (v1.11): the card has no intended-use statement, or the row gives none.

appraisal.description: getConceptMetrics and exportConcept only (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §22): how a linked study entered the evidence grade; absent when none did.

guideline_followed.description: Null exactly when the guideline is none.

model_version.description: The model version the study evaluated, or null.

population_id.description: v1.13 (§26): the local population a hospital evaluation evaluated; null for public.

applicability.description: v1.14 (§22): applicability concerns, the overall judgement (PROBAST+AI style); absent when not stated. Never graded.

applicability_notes.description: v1.14 (§22): notes on the applicability judgement; absent when none.

quality_tool.description: v1.14 (§22): the appraisal tool; absent when not stated.

setting_category.description: v1.14 (§22): the setting category beside the free-text setting; absent when not stated.

study_id.description: The study that measured the effect (Studies, §22).

codes.description: ICD-11 codes as given; empty for an effect on a whole chapter.

condition_ids.description: The depth-1 condition of each code, in the same order.

chapter_id.description: The chapter the effect concerns as a whole, or null.

comparator.description: What care with the AI system was compared with, e.g. "Usual care without the AI system".

effect_measure.description: Ratios (risk, odds, hazard) have the null value 1; differences the null value 0.

ci_low.description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval (≤ estimate; > 0 for a ratio).

ci_high.description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval (≥ estimate).

unit.description: The unit of a difference, e.g. "minutes", or null.

direction.description: Which side of the null value favours the AI system.

appraisal_tool.description: RoB 2 for a randomized trial, ROBINS-I for a prospective study or a real-world deployment.

judgement.description: The overall risk-of-bias judgement; critical with ROBINS-I only.

study.description: The study record of the version (design, setting, who ran it); null when the version's studies set no longer holds it.

EffectList.description: listEffects (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §27): the effects of the version, in stored order.

study.description: The linked study; null for an aggregated row (rollup, lens fallback).

study_adjustment.description: The change to the evidence signal: the study's guideline and risk-of-bias adjustment, or for an aggregated row the mean over its rows.

applied.description: Whether the row's evidence signal is derived (and so includes the adjustment).

terms.description: Stored rows with a derived signal only; else null.

penalties.description: The sum of the §4.2 penalties that apply (0 or negative).

signal.description: The served evidence_signal: the sum of the above, clamped to 0–1.

incidents.description: Safety incidents of the card that apply to the concept at the lens, closed ones included, newest first (v1.7). Rollups list those of their conditions.

effects.description: Intervention effects of the card that concern the concept (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §27), in stored order; a rollup lists those of its conditions. Absent when there are none. Never part of any grade.

mapping.description: Reads in another ontology (v1.13) only: the condition's crosswalk to ICD-11; null for chapters and blocks (rollups), kind none for one none of whose conditions maps.

other_parents.description: Reads in another ontology (v1.13), conditions only: the parents besides the primary one (MONDO is a graph).

ontology.description: The ontology this answer is read in (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §23); absent for ICD-11.

public_metrics.description: v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26): when metrics is a local result (provenance.layer local), the card's public row for the same concept and lens under the same prevalence, or null when there is none; absent otherwise.

groups.description: Every one-group lens: each specific age, then sex, then ethnicity value (axis order of /meta), the other axes at All.

code.description: An ICD-11 MMS code, e.g. 5A11 or 1A03.0. Letters, digits, and dots only.

LookupPopulation.description: Coarse population values only; null or absent means the whole population on that axis (422 invalid_lens otherwise).

intended_use.description: The intended-use level; null when there is no row.

LookupCondition.description: A code that names a level-2 concept: what getConceptMetrics serves for it at the lens and version.

anchor_id.description: The depth-1 condition whose row the concept shows (its own id at depth 1).

provenance.description: Null when the condition has no row at the lens.

LookupUnmatchedCondition.description: A code that names no level-2 concept of the atlas.

LookupCombination.description: The stored combination of the matched conditions (CONTRACT.md §8); never inferred.

concept_ids.description: The matched conditions as depth-1 anchors, in request order.

Lookup.description: The lookup's answer (v1.8, CONTRACT.md §19). Synthetic demonstration data; not for clinical use.

card_url.description: The card on the atlas, relative to the frontend root.

intended_use_defined.description: Whether the card has an intended-use statement (v1.11); absent means true.

conditions.description: One entry per code, in request order.

population.description: The local population this answer uses (v1.10, CONTRACT.md §21); absent for the default population.

counts.description: E.g. models, use_cases, metric_rows, combinations, codes.

staged_upload_id.description: The newest staged upload (checking, invalid, or valid) of this kind.

staged_upload_ids.description: Every staged upload of this kind, newest first (metrics and multimorbidity stage one per model and use case).

code.description: E.g. missing_column, unknown_icd_code, out_of_range, ci_low_above_ci_high, unknown_evidence_grade, duplicate_key, unknown_lens_value, very_wide_confidence_interval (backend/README.md lists all).

fix.description: Plain-language instruction for fixing the spreadsheet.

row.description: Spreadsheet row number (the first line of the file is 1); 0 for the whole file.

record.description: Records uploads only (v1.7): the index of the record (row − 2).

target.description: Model and use case of a metrics or multimorbidity upload, or (v1.10) the local population of a population upload; null for the other kinds. Local results (v1.13, §26): the card and population_id; a narrow model card: model_version.

previewed.description: Set when the atlas read this upload with version=staged:<id>.

origin.description: An uploaded file, or JSON records (createRecordsUpload). Added in v1.7.

submission_id.description: v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26): the developer submission the upload belongs to, or null.

settings.description: v1.14 (CONTRACT.md §29): metrics and local results only, per specific care setting the upload touches, in axis order; absent when it touches Any setting only.

samples.description: Up to 50 named rows per kind, in a stable order (CONTRACT.md §11). Added in v1.4.

use_cases.description: Registry uploads: model and use case pairs, written "<model_version> / <use_case>".

status_shifts.description: Shifts of depth-1 conditions at the all-population lens, per view.

targets.description: The same shift per model and use case, most conditions first (CONTRACT.md §11). Added in v1.4.

RowSample.description: One named row of a change summary. Metrics: a condition at a population lens. Prevalence: an ICD-11 code. Multimorbidity: a combination at a lens. Models: a model and use case pair. Added in v1.4.

key.description: Stable key of the row within its data set.

name.description: The condition, combination, or model and use case name.

code.description: ICD-11 code for metrics and prevalence rows.

setting.description: v1.14 (CONTRACT.md §29): the care setting of a metrics row of a specific setting; absent for Any setting.

previewed.description: Whether the maintainer previewed on the atlas; recorded in history, not enforced.

role.description: v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26): the workspace published in (no login); developer is refused (developers submit).

publisher_name.description: v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26): the name entered in the workspace (no login); shown in history.

role.description: v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26): the workspace published in (no login); developer is refused (developers submit).

publisher_name.description: v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26): the name entered in the workspace (no login); shown in history.

ChangeNote.description: Change note (v1.7), at most 500 characters; stored on the version and shown in history.

RecordsUploadRequest.description: JSON records turned into a staged merge upload in template form (v1.7, CONTRACT.md §11.4).

kind.description: studies and effects since v1.13; local_metrics and (with submission_id) models since v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26).

records.description: One object per template row, keyed by column key or header (e.g. incident_id or "Incident ID").

population_id.description: Required for kind=local_metrics (v1.13): the local population.

submission_id.description: v1.13: join this developer submission (kind=models only with it).

kind.description: Null for versions that cover every kind: the initial import (version 1) and rollbacks that restore every kind.

note.description: The change note given on publish or rollback (v1.7), or null.

publisher_role.description: v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26): the workspace it was published in, or null (no login).

publisher_name.description: v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26): the name entered when publishing, or null.

model_version.description: metrics: the card to pass to createRecordsUpload; safety: null.

model.description: Model id; hosted default claude-sonnet-5-5. Required for a local model.

base_url.description: Local: the OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1. Hosted: optional gateway (https).

api_key.description: Write-only. Required for a hosted model unless one is stored; omit it to keep the stored key.

AssistConfigRequest.description: configureAssist body (v1.9). Unknown fields are ignored, and invalid values are never repeated in problem details: the API key is write-only.

truncated.description: Whether the helper read only part of a file: the first 2,000 rows, 100 columns, or 20 sheets of a table, or its first 200,000 characters. Optional; absent means false.

record.description: The record exactly as createRecordsUpload takes it.

base_url.description: Local: the OpenAI-compatible base URL; hosted: a gateway URL, or null for the Anthropic API.

key_set.description: Whether an API key is stored. The key itself is write-only.

how_to_enable.description: Set while the helper is off.

privacy.description: What leaves the machine, and when.

AssistStatus.description: Whether the helper is on, and with which provider. Never the API key.

data_protection_note.description: The organisation's own note on data protection (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §26.2), e.g. a hospital's; sent only when set. In updateInstance, leaving it out clears it.

InstanceProfile.description: The instance profile (contract v1.13, CONTRACT.md §26). No login: it names who runs this copy.

markdown.description: The Markdown text as submitted; null for a JSON card.

NarrowModelCard.description: A developer's narrow model card of one AI system (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §26). Synthetic; never verified.

PublicVersionEntry.description: One published version for operational systems (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §26).

model_version.description: The AI system the submission is about.

Submission.description: A developer submission (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §26): staged uploads that wait for a custodian.

note.description: Change note (v1.7), at most 500 characters; stored on the version and shown in history.

publisher_name.description: v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26): the name entered in the workspace (no login); shown in history.

content.description: The card: JSON, or Markdown with optional simple front matter (at most 1 MB).

ModelCardUploadRequest.description: A narrow model card as text (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §26).

ModelCardProposals.description: Metric records proposed from a narrow model card's results (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §26); nothing is staged.

ReleaseImport.description: A checked public release import of a hospital instance (v1.13, CONTRACT.md §26).

note.description: Change note (v1.7), at most 500 characters; stored on the version and shown in history.

role.description: v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26): the workspace published in (no login); developer is refused (developers submit).

publisher_name.description: v1.13 (CONTRACT.md §26): the name entered in the workspace (no login); shown in history.

content.description: The JSON file of one evaluation run for one card (at most 1 MB).

EvaluationUploadRequest.description: An evaluation results file as text (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §32.2): format bmc-evaluation-results/1.

result.description: The result's position in the file (0-based).

concept_id.description: The depth-1 condition the record is stored on (its anchor for a subcategory).

study.description: One record in the studies template's keys (design benchmark).

EvaluationProposals.description:
Records proposed from a valid evaluation results upload (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §32.2): one benchmark
study record and one metrics merge record per result, for createRecordsUpload (study first). Nothing is staged.

notice.description: Synthetic demonstration data; not a certification, an approval, or evidence.

version.description: The newest published version that changed this configuration (CONTRACT.md §17).

configuration.description: The card's configuration record (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28.1); sent only when one of its fields is given.

CardRecordSummary.description:
The Overview counts over the depth-1 conditions at all patients (the catalogue tile's distributions)
and the conditions by safety mark from the card's public incidents.

intended_use.description: The chapter's intended-use level, no_data without one; null for a card without an intended-use statement.

perf.description: The chapter rollup's performance (0–1), or null.

overall_counts.description: The chapter's conditions by Overview status.

atlas.description: The card on the atlas, relative to the frontend root (atlas.html?…).

narrow_model_card.description: The developer's narrow model card (API path), or null when none is published.

status.description: Registry status; the catalogue's status filter uses it (CONTRACT.md §17).

replaces.description: Version lineage (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28.2): the model version this AI system supersedes; sent only when given.

replaced_by.description: Version lineage (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §28.2): the entries that supersede this one (derived); sent only when not empty.

system.description: The registry entry ("AI system") of a tile (CONTRACT.md §11.1).

incidents.description: The card's public safety incidents, newest first.

CardRecord.description: ``getCardRecord`` (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §32.1): one card for operational systems. Synthetic; never a certification.

extension.description: broad-modelcard: the default card, the dataset version, and the notice.

detail.description: Short markdown: status, top warnings, safeguards, open incidents, the synthetic-data line.

extension.description: broad-modelcard: the code, its system, the mapping, statuses, and safety mark.

CdsResponse.description: One CDS card per condition of the request (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §33). Synthetic; not for clinical use.

CardRecordLd.description: getCardRecord with format=jsonld (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §32.3): the CardRecord content with @context, @id, and @type; MCRO terms for model details, intended use, and quantitative analysis, bmc: otherwise.

patient.description: FHIR Patient: birthDate and gender are read.

conditions.description: FHIR Bundle of Condition resources, code.coding in ICD-11 MMS or ICD-10-CM.

extension.description: broad-modelcard: {card_id, setting?, population?}; absent: the registry's default card.

CdsHooksRequest.description: A CDS Hooks 2.0 patient-view request (v1.14, CONTRACT.md §33), parsed by hand; at most 64 KB.
